# How to Use This File

Runs the Japanese extraction from CHILDES token import through negation coding to the processed Feather export. Set the working directory to `japanese`, install `childesr`, `tidyverse`, and `arrow`, then run chunks in order. Matching raw caches are reused unless `japanese_force_download` is `TRUE`; the final file is `japanese_data/processed_data/japanese_tokens_processed.feather`.

# Setup

Loads the packages, sets knitr options, and creates relative raw and processed data directories.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)
library(childesr)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r directories}
japanese_db_version <- "2026.1"
japanese_force_download <- FALSE

japanese_data_root <- "japanese_data"

japanese_raw_dir <- file.path(japanese_data_root, "raw_data")
japanese_processed_dir <- file.path(japanese_data_root, "processed_data")

dir.create(japanese_raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(japanese_processed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load Data

Loads the selected Japanese corpora from CHILDES release 2026.1 or matching local caches. Validates the imported columns and cache source record before token processing.

```{r collections}
japanese_target_collection <- "Japanese"
```

## Import Tokens

Loads a matching raw cache or requests tokens for the selected corpus or collection. Validates columns and row counts, then saves new raw data with its query source record.

```{r import_tokens}
# Only use caches belonging to the pinned release and the same query.
japanese_feather_path <- file.path(japanese_raw_dir, "all_japanese_tokens.feather")
japanese_csv_path <- file.path(japanese_raw_dir, "all_japanese_tokens.csv")
japanese_source_info_path <- file.path(japanese_raw_dir, "all_japanese_tokens_source.rds")

japanese_query_roles <- c("Target_Child", "Mother", "Father")

japanese_query_info <- list(
  db_version = japanese_db_version,
  collection = sort(japanese_target_collection),
  role = sort(japanese_query_roles),
  token = "%",
  replace = TRUE
)

japanese_cache_info <- if (file.exists(japanese_source_info_path)) {
  tryCatch(readRDS(japanese_source_info_path), error = function(e) NULL)
} else {
  NULL
}

japanese_cache_matches <- is.list(japanese_cache_info) &&
  identical(japanese_cache_info$query, japanese_query_info)

japanese_loaded_from_cache <- FALSE

if (!japanese_force_download && japanese_cache_matches && file.exists(japanese_feather_path)) {

  cat(sprintf(
    "Loading verified childes-db %s Feather cache...\n",
    japanese_db_version
  ))

  japanese_all_tokens <- arrow::read_feather(japanese_feather_path)
  japanese_loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else if (!japanese_force_download && japanese_cache_matches && file.exists(japanese_csv_path)) {

  cat(sprintf(
    "Loading verified childes-db %s CSV cache...\n",
    japanese_db_version
  ))

  japanese_all_tokens <- readr::read_csv(
    japanese_csv_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  japanese_loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else {

  cat(sprintf(
    "Downloading Japanese tokens from childes-db %s...\n",
    japanese_db_version
  ))

  japanese_all_tokens <- childesr::get_tokens(
    collection = japanese_target_collection,
    role = japanese_query_roles,
    token = "%",
    replace = TRUE,
    db_version = japanese_db_version
  )
}

# Avoid saving an empty/failed download.
if (is.null(japanese_all_tokens) || nrow(japanese_all_tokens) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No tokens returned. Check the query messages and collection name; ",
    "no cache was saved."
  )
}

# Check that the expected columns are available.
japanese_required_columns <- c(
  "target_child_id", "target_child_age", "transcript_id", "utterance_id",
  "token_order", "gloss", "part_of_speech", "speaker_role",
  "speaker_code", "utterance_type"
)

japanese_missing_columns <- setdiff(
  japanese_required_columns,
  names(japanese_all_tokens)
)

if (length(japanese_missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Required columns missing: ",
    paste(japanese_missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Confirm that the cached data matches its source record.
if (
  japanese_loaded_from_cache &&
  !isTRUE(nrow(japanese_all_tokens) == japanese_cache_info$row_count)
) {
  stop(
    "Cache row count does not match its source record. ",
    "Set japanese_force_download <- TRUE and rerun."
  )
}

if (!japanese_loaded_from_cache) {

  cat("Saving the new data and its release/query information...\n")

  arrow::write_feather(japanese_all_tokens, japanese_feather_path)
  readr::write_csv(japanese_all_tokens, japanese_csv_path)

  saveRDS(
    list(
      query = japanese_query_info,
      downloaded_at_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      childesr_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("childesr")),
      row_count = nrow(japanese_all_tokens)
    ),
    japanese_source_info_path
  )

} else if (!file.exists(japanese_feather_path)) {

  arrow::write_feather(japanese_all_tokens, japanese_feather_path)
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Loaded %d tokens from %d children.\n",
  nrow(japanese_all_tokens),
  japanese_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()
))
```

# Token Processing

Screens target-child ages, records exclusion counts, and adds speaker, completed-month age, and utterance-type labels.

## Exclusions

Keeps finite target-child ages from birth to under 72 months. Counts tokens and unique child IDs, including a missing ID as one distinct value, and retains observed tokens at ages 0–10.

```{r exclusions}
japanese_n_tokens_before_exclusions <- nrow(japanese_all_tokens)
japanese_n_chi_before_exclusions <- japanese_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

japanese_tokens <- japanese_all_tokens

japanese_tokens <- japanese_tokens %>%
  filter(is.finite(target_child_age))
japanese_n_tokens_after_finite_age <- nrow(japanese_tokens)
japanese_n_chi_after_finite_age <- japanese_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

japanese_tokens <- japanese_tokens %>%
  filter(target_child_age >= 0, target_child_age < 72)
japanese_n_tokens_after_age_range <- nrow(japanese_tokens)
japanese_n_chi_after_age_range <- japanese_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

japanese_exclusions <- tibble(
  n_tokens_before_exclusions = japanese_n_tokens_before_exclusions,
  n_after_finite_age = japanese_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  n_after_age_range = japanese_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  missing_or_nonfinite_age =
    japanese_n_tokens_before_exclusions - japanese_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  outside_age_range =
    japanese_n_tokens_after_finite_age - japanese_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  n_chi_total = japanese_n_chi_before_exclusions,
  n_chi_after_finite_age = japanese_n_chi_after_finite_age,
  n_chi_after_age_range = japanese_n_chi_after_age_range
)

japanese_exclusions
```

## Save Exclusion Records

Saves the exclusion summary and retained token rows as CSV files in the raw-data directory.

```{r save_exclusions}
readr::write_csv(
  japanese_exclusions,
  file.path(japanese_raw_dir, "exclusions_japanese_summary.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  japanese_tokens,
  file.path(japanese_raw_dir, "japanese_tokens_excluded.csv")
)
```

## Speaker Roles

Maps target-child roles to `child` and mother or father roles to `parent` after case normalization. Stops if a role is missing or unexpected.

```{r speaker_roles}
japanese_tokens <- japanese_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") == "target_child" ~ "child",
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") %in%
        c("mother", "father") ~ "parent",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

if (anyNA(japanese_tokens$speaker)) {
  japanese_invalid_speaker_roles <- unique(as.character(japanese_tokens$speaker_role[is.na(japanese_tokens$speaker)]))
  japanese_invalid_speaker_roles[is.na(japanese_invalid_speaker_roles)] <- "<missing>"
  stop("Unexpected or missing speaker roles: ", paste(japanese_invalid_speaker_roles, collapse = ", "))
}
```

## Age

Calculates completed-month age by flooring the screened target-child age.

```{r age}
japanese_tokens$age <- japanese_tokens$target_child_age %>% floor()
```

## Utterance Types

Recodes specified question, imperative, and disrupted utterance labels; leaves unlisted labels unchanged.

```{r utterance_types}
# Prepare the utterance_type categories for this study based on the utterance_types in childes-db
## Categories: declarative, imperative, interrogative, and other
japanese_tokens$utterance_type <-
  recode(japanese_tokens$utterance_type,
         question = "interrogative",
         `broken for coding` = "other",
         `imperative_emphatic` = "imperative",
         interruption = "other",
         `interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `missing CA terminator` = "other",
         `no break TCU continuation` = "other",
         `question exclamation` = "interrogative",
         `quotation next line` = "other",
         `quotation precedes` = "other",
         `self interruption` = "other",
         `self interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `trail off` = "other",
         `trail off question` = "interrogative"
  )
```

# Define Target Words

Matches Romanized, hiragana, and katakana spellings of `nai` and `iya`, then assigns function-word labels.

## Candidate Spellings

Defines the Romanized, hiragana, and katakana variants used for exact negator matching.

```{r candidate_spellings}
japanese_nai_variants <- c("nai", "ない", "ナイ")
japanese_iya_variants <- c("iya", "いや", "イヤ")
```

## Nai and Iya Matching

Maps case-insensitive gloss matches to normalized `nai` or `iya` in `word`.

```{r function_words}
# Initialize word column as nonfunction
japanese_tokens$word <- "nonfunction"

# Map orthographic variants (Romanized, Hiragana, Katakana) to normalized lemmas
japanese_tokens$word[tolower(japanese_tokens$gloss) %in% tolower(japanese_nai_variants)] <- "nai"
japanese_tokens$word[tolower(japanese_tokens$gloss) %in% tolower(japanese_iya_variants)] <- "iya"
```

## Word Categories

Labels matched negators `Negation` and other tokens `nonfunction`.

```{r wordcategories}
japanese_tokens$word_category <- "nonfunction"
japanese_tokens$word_category[japanese_tokens$word %in% c("nai", "iya")] <- "Negation"
```

## Syntactic Category

Labels identified function words `Function` and other tokens `nonfunction`.

```{r syncategory}
japanese_tokens$syncategory <- "Function"
japanese_tokens$syncategory[japanese_tokens$word_category == "nonfunction"] <- "nonfunction"
```

# Negation Word Normalization

Copies matched `nai` or `iya` labels into `negation_category`; unmatched tokens receive a missing value.

```{r negation_clean}
japanese_tokens <- japanese_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    negation_category = case_when(
      word == "nai" ~ "nai",
      word == "iya" ~ "iya",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Sentential vs. Discourse Negation

Labels normalized `nai` as `sentential` and `iya` as `discourse`, leaving other tokens without a scope.

```{r negation_categorization}
japanese_tokens <- japanese_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    negation_scope = case_when(
      is.na(negation_category) ~ NA_character_,
      negation_category == "nai" ~ "sentential",
      negation_category == "iya" ~ "discourse",
      TRUE ~ "uncertain"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of("neg_type")) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Save Processed Data

Saves the annotated token table to `japanese_data/processed_data/japanese_tokens_processed.feather`.

```{r save_processed_data}
write_feather(
  japanese_tokens,
  file.path(japanese_processed_dir, "japanese_tokens_processed.feather")
)
```
